sv.title: Här startar julen i klassiska bruksmiljön – redan i november
sv.summary: På Huseby bruk i Alvesta kommun startade man med julmarknad redan den sjunde november. SVT Småland åkte dit och frågade vad besökare och personal tycker om att julen redan dragit igång.

en.title: Christmas starts in the classic mill community – as early as November
en.summary: At Huseby bruk in Alvesta municipality, a Christmas market started as early as 7 November. SVT Småland went there and asked visitors and staff what they think about Christmas already getting under way.

sv.title: Fritidsgården håller öppet oftare efter skadan på Strömsundsbron
sv.summary: När Strömsundsbron stängde såg man att barn och ungdomar hängde runt i samhället i väntan på träningar eller andra aktiviteter. De tog sig inte hem och tillbaka. Då togs beslutet att öppna fritidsgården fler dagar i veckan.

en.title: Youth centre open more often after damage to the Strömsund bridge
en.summary: When the Strömsund bridge closed, children and young people were seen hanging around the community while waiting for training or other activities. They could not get home and back. The decision was then taken to open the youth centre more days a week.

sv.title: Klackbergstunneln i Norberg öppen igen efter fyra år
sv.summary: Efter stenras spärrades gruvtunneln i Klackberg utanför Norberg av sommaren 2022. Nu har den tio meter långa tunneln öppnat igen – fyra år senare. – Det betyder jättemycket. Det blir lättare att naturligt röra sig i området, säger Ida Långbacka på Norbergs kommun.

en.title: Klackberg tunnel in Norberg open again after four years
en.summary: After a rockfall, the Klackberg mine tunnel outside Norberg was closed from summer 2022. Now the ten-metre tunnel has reopened – four years later. "It means a lot. It becomes easier to move naturally in the area," says Ida Långbacka at Norberg Municipality.

sv.title: Skönhetsoperationen inifrån: ”Det är inte ofarligt”
sv.summary: Plastikkirurgen Tyge Tindholdt skrubbar händerna rena utanför operationssalen i Malmö. Om några minuter ska han operera en kvinna som gått ner mycket i vikt. Han säger att han aldrig haft så mycket att göra som nu. – Många tycker att det ”bara” är plastikkirurgi, men patienten sövs.

en.title: Cosmetic surgery from the inside: "It is not harmless"
en.summary: Plastic surgeon Tyge Tindholdt scrubs his hands clean outside the operating theatre in Malmö. In a few minutes he is to operate on a woman who has lost a lot of weight. He says he has never had so much to do as now. – Many think it is "just" plastic surgery, but the patient is put under anaesthesia.

sv.title: Glömde föremål i patientens huvud

en.title: Stuck on the balcony of a burning house – rescued by neighbours in Piteå
en.summary: When Sofia Wellborg saw her neighbour in his 90s standing trapped on the balcony of the burning villa, she understood that every second could be decisive. Together with two other neighbours, she managed to get him down from the house.

sv.title: Södra Förstadsgatan har öppnat igen: ”Det är amazing”

en.title: Södra Förstadsgatan has reopened: "It's amazing"
en.summary: The last ground slab is in place. On Friday afternoon, the stretch between Spångatan and Föreningsgatan was opened for both bicycles and cars. But they have to adapt to pedestrians. "It looks a bit complicated," said motorist Maria Nunes.

en.title: Drunk golf tournament ended in a ditch in Trosa
en.summary: Over the summer, a group of lads' annual drunk golf tournament came to an embarrassing end. What was meant to be a finale in the clubhouse instead became an overturned golf cart in the ditch.

sv.title: Han har bott på Chalmers parkering i fyra år: ”Helt okej”
sv.summary: En studentbostad precis intill universitetet för under 2 000 kronor i månaden. Det har 25-åriga Pontus Liljeberg ordnat genom att bygga om en skåpbil och parkera den utanför Chalmers tekniska högskola i Göteborg. – Det bästa är flexibiliteten, säger han.

en.title: He has lived in the Chalmers parking lot for four years: "Totally fine"
en.summary: A student flat right next to the university for under SEK 2,000 a month. 25-year-old Pontus Liljeberg has arranged this by converting a van and parking it outside Chalmers University of Technology in Göteborg. – The best part is the flexibility, he says.

sv.title: Protester när hyllat stöd för födande kvinnor skrotas: ”Oacceptabelt och ovärdigt”
sv.summary: Trots goda resultat vill Region Skåne lägga ner det hyllade förlossningsprojektet ”Min barnmorska” i Malmö. På lördag demonstrerar tidigare patienter, barnmorskor och oppositionspolitiker mot beslutet – bland dem Tove Jansson, som beskriver stödet hon fick som ovärderligt.

en.title: Protests as acclaimed support for birthing women is scrapped: "Unacceptable and unworthy"
en.summary: Despite good results, Region Skåne wants to shut down the acclaimed childbirth project "Min barnmorska" in Malmö. Region Stockholm has decided to convert Safiren from an LSS home into a healthcare unit, meaning the children can remain in the same premises with the same staff. – We are more than grateful.

en.title: Mother disappeared before the E20 accident in Mariestad
en.summary: The long-awaited trip to Skara Sommarland ended in tragedy. Two adults and a child died in a head-on collision – a child was taken to hospital. But the story also involves a mother who has vanished.

sv.title: Efter hästdöd i Timrå – fler stall stänger för besökare

en.title: After horse deaths in Timrå – more stables close to visitors

en.title: Influenza season already under way – here's what to think about
en.summary: The influenza season has started earlier than usual this year, at the same time as covid-19 is rising across the country. en.title: Electricity company receives largest sanction fee so far for security protection shortcomings
en.summary: Several operations important to Sweden's security have had shortcomings in their security protection against, for example, espionage and sabotage, judged serious enough that they have had to pay millions in so-called sanction fees, according to an Ekot investigation.
